name: Voiceflow
description: Embeds a Voiceflow chatbot widget site-wide by project ID, with per-path exclusions; submodule publishes a public content index feed.
project_description:
Voiceflow is a module that allows direct integration of chatbots developed with Voiceflow into your website. This module is ideal for those looking to improve user interaction through Voiceflow's automated voice assistants or conversational chatbots.

 Key features: 
 
 Quick integration: quickly add Voiceflow chatbot to any page on the site. 
 Path control: Exclude chatbot integration on specific paths using intuitive settings. 
 
 Usage: 
 
 Initial configuration: Go to /admin/config/system/voiceflow , activate the chatbot (disabled by default). 
 Configure Voiceflow Chatbot: Add the Project ID provided by Voiceflow. 
 Path management: Easily define exclusion paths where the chatbot should not appear (The module already provides basic paths to exclude by default). 
 
 This module helps developers and site administrators to quickly and efficiently integrate Voiceflow Chatbot, improving user engagement and leveraging the power of voice assistants.

 Back to top 

 Voiceflow Index submodule 
 Voiceflow Index submodule extends the functionality of the Voiceflow module by allowing specific contents to be indexed for use by the Voiceflow Chatbot.

 Usage: 
 
 Select content types: Go to /admin/config/system/voiceflow/index , and enable in which content types you want the "voiceflow_index" checkbox to appear. 
 Node forms: In the node add/edit forms select whether you want that node to be included in the Voiceflow index. 
 XML Index: All nodes marked for indexing will be seen in /voiceflow.xml. 
 Back to top
